description: This source file defines an immutable Java class 'ModifyFeatureDefinition' which represents a command to modify a feature's definition within an Eclipse Ditto-based IoT platform. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, serialization logic, and relevant fields such as 'thingId', 'featureId', and 'definition'.
